Pattern: Procedural pattern on each projection plane. noise: fbm noise; voronoi: cell pattern; stripes: parallel lines; grid: line grid; checker: checkerboard; texture: project the in1 TOP.
Space: object: pattern sticks to the mesh (uses object position/normal). world: pattern stays fixed in the scene while the mesh moves.
Scale: Pattern cells per world unit. Higher = finer pattern.
Sharpness: Triplanar blend exponent. Higher = harder seams between the three projections, lower = softer blending.
Color1: First pattern colour (dark side of the pattern).
Color2: Second pattern colour (bright side of the pattern).
Roughness: Surface roughness. 0 = mirror-like highlights, 1 = fully diffuse.
Metallic: 0 = dielectric, 1 = metal (reflections tinted by the pattern colour).
Contrast: Pattern contrast around mid-grey. 1 = unchanged, higher = harsher, lower = flatter.
Bump: Strength of the bump derived from the pattern. 0 = flat shading.
Linewidth: Line width for the stripes and grid patterns, in pattern-cell units. Ignored by other patterns.
Octaves: Number of fbm layers for the noise pattern. More = finer detail, slightly more cost.
Texscale: Texture tiling per world unit when Pattern is texture.
Animate: Noise travel radius and voronoi point motion over the looping phase. 0 = static.
Scroll: Whole pattern scroll cycles per preview loop (integer, negative reverses). 0 = no scroll.
Modamount: Scales the in2 modulation CHOP (band1 adds to Contrast). 0 = ignore modulation.
Turns: Full rotations of the preview objects per loop cycle. 0 = still.
Background: Background colour of the preview render.
Camdistance: Preview camera distance from the objects, in world units.
Showtorus: Show the torus in the preview render.
Showsphere: Show the sphere in the preview render.
